actualOutcomeReview: Require exactly the five selected method identities, each started and passed, and one successful suite/overall summary for five Swift Testing methods. Zero XCTest methods alone provides no acceptance.

Require each of the ten Boolean argument tuples above to have its own actual started/passed case event. The one parameterless passed method supplies the eleventh case; do not invent a parameterized event for it.

For the two-argument method require the full Cartesian product false/false,false/true,true/false,true/true with exact parameter names. Check unordered identity sets and uniqueness, not presumed scheduling order.

Reject missing, duplicate, extra, failed or skipped selected outcomes; inspect recorded issue/diagnostic lines. Preserve actual FAIL and unknown-format evidence instead of relabeling it or rerunning tests.
The runner method summary remains original authority, supplemented by independent case-event inspection. Declared case counts are not substituted for observed completed cases.

compilerReadbackPlan.pathAuthority: Only exact actual paths read from verbose compiler command lines inside the owned component build root; no guessed FileList path or original-App proof reuse.

requiredModules.generatedSource: Read and separately hash the actual SwiftPM test_anchor.swift, if present; verify it is the generated anchor for this test module, not an unreviewed test/body.
Read and separately hash the actual generated test_entry_point.swift and consumed FileList; this is infrastructure, not another test source.

witnessRequirements: Retain raw FileList bytes with exact absolute source paths, byte count/hash and member source hashes; compare each tracked input against current fixed pins.
For each module retain actual builtin-SwiftDriver or equivalent swiftc command consuming that exact @FileList. Write-file announcements or existence of a list alone are insufficient.
Retain the original command line and its stderr line number; hash the raw line bytes with newline policy recorded explicitly. Extract actual module,target and inner-driver jobs from that line.

Read actual generated anchor and runner sources rather than infer their bytes from the earlier G04 run. Reject extra compiled test/product sources; preserve unexpected compiler format as an inspection gap pending bounded actual readback, not a new compiler invocation.

rawEvidenceReadback: Retain exact input-staging receipt and executed wrapper/runner pins; preserve original raw bytes and actual final Sentinel job result.

Read and independently hash receipt.json, invocation.json, process.json, resource-samples.json, source-inputs-before.json, source-inputs-after.json, stdout.original.log, stderr.original.log and toolchain.original.log from the actual attempt.
Match all original receipt artifact entries to exact readback bytes/hashes. Compare source inventories before/after and compiled component copies to the four fixed Package/model/Core/test pins.
Use only the original recorded process return and positive ABSENT_ESRCH cleanup latch. Never probe the former process/group again.

Confirm original argv --jobs1 --no-parallel, exact suite filter,300s command, one actual invocation, actual admission/live samples and no timeout/resource-stop/cleanup/evidence-finalization failure. Record actual inner SwiftDriver -j separately.
scopeLimits: Exact new model plus unchanged full Core Models.swift in a derived minimal package.
